learning_outcomes.text: Possesses basic knowledge necessary to understand the ex-technical conditions of engineering activity, possesses basic knowledge on management, including quality management and running commercial enterprise, within the range of protection of intellectual property and patent law; knows general principles of creating and developing forms of individual entrepreneurship and basic HSE rules applicable to machine industry. The student is able to use patent databases and knows the standards and tests related to the introduction of a new biomedical material to the market.
The student is able to choose the material for the implant depending on its purpose.
The student is able to test selected properties of the biomedical material (e.g. wettability).
The student is able to use the database literature resources in order to find the necessary information.

syllabus_topics: Literature databases, patent databases and standards related to biomedical materials.
Characteristics, structure and application of titanium and its alloys used as biomaterials.
Influence of surface treatment on the corrosion resistance of metal materials for implants for bone surgery.
Technologies for producing hydroxyapatite coatings by electrophoretic method.
assessment_rules: The passing threshold for the laboratory is 56.0%.
bibliography: M. Kutz, Biomaterials Engineering and Design Handbook, McGraw-Hill 2009
I. Corni , M.P. Ryan, A.R. Boccaccini , Electrophoretic deposition : From traditional ceramics to nanotechnology , Journal of the European Ceramic Society . 28 (2008) 1353 1367.
Rosario Pignatello, Biomaterials Science and Engineering, InTech, Croatia, 2011.
B.D. Ratner, A.S. Hoffman, F.J. Schoen, J.E. Lemons, Biomaterials Science, Academic Press, San Diego, 1996
Q. Chen, G.A. Thouas, Metallic implant biomaterials, Materials Science and Engineering R: Reports. 87 (2015) 157
degree: Mechanical Engineering, first-cycle (engineer), specialization Design and Production Engineering
